newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Two Cyprus brokerage firms merge.
newsitem.headline: Two Cyprus brokerage firms merge.

text.p: Cyprus's Sigma Severis and Athienitis Securities (SSA) brokers have clinched a cooperation deal with Hailisco Stockbrokers as part of an expansion drive, SSA chairman Nicos Severis said on Wednesday.
Under terms of the deal, which came into effect on Monday, SSA has taken over Hailisco activities on the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE).
"We have not assumed any assets or liabilities. We simply execute their (Hailisco) client transactions," he said, adding that Hailisco owner Demetrakis Hailis has joined SSA as an associate.
Severis said SSA's efficient administration procedure systems meant it could hold out under present difficult conditions on the CSE.
"We have been having low volumes. We expect it to pick up soon but for months now there have been low volumes and overheads are running," he said.
By October 15, all of the island's stock brokerage firms will be obliged to show a net capital of 200,000 pounds in order to qualify for underwriting business.
SSA has a paid up capital of 200,000 of which 60 percent is owned by Severis and Athienitis Financial Services and 40 percent by Sigma Securities of Greece.
Severis said that the SSA and Hailisco deal brought the group up to the third position on the CSE list in terms of market share with 11 percent of transactions.
